GemPredict mobile image processing components

heic-to 1.6.6 (unmodified upstream library, separately lazy-loaded)
Copyright: upstream contributors, https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to
License: GNU LGPL v3 or later; see heic-to-LICENSE.txt and GPL-3.txt.
Exact package and its source/build scripts:
https://registry.npmjs.org/heic-to/-/heic-to-1.6.6.tgz
https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to
The package bundles libheif 1.23.6, including HEVC decoding components.
Corresponding upstream source and build instructions:
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/tree/v1.23.6
https://github.com/strukturag/libde265
No modifications to these libraries were made. The decoder is bundled locally,
not fetched from these URLs during a scan. It runs in the browser; originals
are not sent to a third-party image-conversion service.

sharp 0.35.5 (server-only)

License: Apache-2.0; see sharp-LICENSE.txt.
Native dependency notices and licenses are distributed with the installed
@img/sharp-* and @img/sharp-libvips-* npm packages in the server dependencies.
